gate: G5 Stage 1 - EgoStitch E2E rev-3.2 single-stage plan-bound screen
spec_binding: docs/05-egostitch-spec.md §13.19 (single-stage plan-bound experiment) and §14.4 in full
draft_boundary: This DRAFT authorizes no formal training, candidate/test scoring, external held-out read, or scientific claim. Only the owner may promote this plan to BINDING after the plan identity and required input evidence are resolved. A BINDING registration is immutable.

predecessor.historical_boundary: The completed rev-3.0 four-arm-plus-control screen and every artifact bound to v2 remain unchanged historical evidence; none is relabelled as rev-3.2 evidence.
predecessor.role_in_v4: v2 is the sole source of the formal-stage acceptance thresholds re-pinned below (primary_criteria, guards, operating_point, comparators, evaluator, e2e_rules, verdict_rule, failure_reading) and of the registered optimizer-group clip norms, which stay registered once, there.

superseded_draft.retained: kept on disk as history; never bound, so it authorized nothing and no artifact cites it as governing
what_v4_removes: the five-gate prebinding_qualification block (G3.1 slot recall, G3.2 Pi-consistency v2, G3.3 degree-partialled clustering R2, G3.4 6a-v3 clustering-MMD movement, G3.5 matched edge-AUPRC guard) - the ladder that computed them is deleted, and G3.4/G3.5 were unsatisfiable as drafted (their thresholds required scoring, scoring required BINDING, BINDING required those thresholds)
protocol.v_select 'sealed until first bound run' (V_select is no longer a universe; V_hold := V_qual union V_select serves both stages)
the calibration/qualification pre-binding probe scopes (E2EProbeScope is now formal_train only)
every unresolved-marker string of the retired grep-discoverable convention; unresolved binding evidence is now explicit JSON null, which every consuming validator already fails closed on

design_trail.authority: decision trail only; docs/05-egostitch-spec.md §13.19 and §14.4 govern

evidence_class_rule.rule: This ladder never emits evidence_class 'inference' at any seed count. Only E1/E3 carry inference (CLAUDE.md; protocol §5.0.5), which additionally requires the spec §8 30-config HPO-parity budget and Holm over the pre-registered held-out assembled family - neither of which a Stage-1-descended screen has. Screening several registered seeds adds cross-seed variance reporting only, never significance or cross-seed robustness.
evidence_class_rule.enforcement: src/experiments/g5_stage1.py::_enforce_engineering_evidence_class refuses the artifact before it is written if evidence_class is anything else or if p_value/ci/holm is non-null at any nesting depth.

scope: single-seed engineering screen; no statistical-significance or cross-seed-robustness claim at any seed count
task_definition: Generated and stitched topology is intermediate context for topology-conditioned binary edge prediction on queried unseen-node pairs; it is not a graph-generation objective.

claims.primary: A valid rev-3.2 topology-conditioned encoder improves edge-level and assembled-graph evidence together over calibrated independent scoring while passing the matched edge-AUPRC guard.
claims.supporting: The registered controls and ablations attribute any improvement to relational structure rather than only pair/content capacity, grounding-vocabulary width, or the train-only relational auxiliary head.
claims.anti_claim: A random, collapsed, warm-start-only, numerically unstable, unqualified, or DRAFT-backed checkpoint cannot count as formal evidence for or against the architecture.

execution_plan.shape: one plan-bound formal training stage followed by provenance-bound scoring and evaluation
execution_plan.training: full V_fit, registered 30-epoch schedule, registered seeds
execution_plan.validation: V_hold for checkpoint selection and telemetry
preflight: registration status is BINDING and the registration SHA-256 is recorded at run start
the exact registered arm/config path and SHA-256 match the live clean implementation
required input packs/manifests and data-boundary audit evidence match their registered digests
execution_plan.quality_policy: All model-quality predicates are telemetry-only. Eligibility, liveness, slot-collapse, clipping/family/RMS margins, AUPRC, dispersion, and precision quality misses cannot block training completion, checkpoint publication, scoring, or evaluation.
execution_plan.truthfulness_failures: Non-finite tensors, DDP disagreement, incomplete or duplicate coverage, data-boundary violations, malformed or hash-mismatched inputs/artifacts, and I/O/infrastructure failures still fail closed.

cosine_pool.difference_from_full: status-quo top-20 cosine grounding pool only

no_l_rel.difference_from_full: L_rel component weight is zero; the train-only relational head remains excluded from every scored logit

algorithm.operation: within-pair slot-axis permutations of A_hat_src, A_hat_dst, and Pi at scaffold-build input, followed by a complete scaffold rebuild
canonical-pair-keyed checkerboard rewiring followed by a complete scaffold rebuild
algorithm.draws: N_swap = 8 * K^2; keyed u in (0, 1); off-diagonal cells only
algorithm.slot_adjacency_swap_space: pi-weighted space W_ij = pi_i * A_hat_zero_diag_ij * pi_j, symmetrized; map back as A_hat_zero_diag_prime_ij = W_prime_ij / (pi_i * pi_j)
algorithm.plan_swap_space: Pi directly, using infinite recipient capacity because Pi is not mapped back through the bounded A_hat sigmoid domain
algorithm.transfer: delta = u * min(w_il, w_kj, c_ij - w_ij, c_kl - w_kl)
algorithm.plan_recipient_capacity: infinity; the transfer reduces to u * min(w_il, w_kj)
binding_invariants: rebuilt STAR degree channel preserved to fp32 tolerance
rebuilt INTRA degree channel preserved to fp32 tolerance
rebuilt ALIGN degree channel preserved to fp32 tolerance
algorithm.deliberately_not_invariant: rebuilt CLOSE degree channel; closure mass is the higher-order signal this control destroys

arm_schema_note: Eight arms: six trained checkpoints plus two scoring-time controls over full's selected checkpoint. Dropping structure_control_6e_v1 would silently delete the degree-preserving rewiring control that protocol §E4.16(e) calls decisive; it is registered here as reported evidence with no verdict effect (see e2e_rules.structure_control_condition).

training_contract.outer_objective: L = L_edge + lambda_real * L_real + lambda_ssl * L_ssl + lambda_recon * L_recon
training_contract.optimizer_groups_source: docs/registrations/g5_e2e_stage1_preregistration_v2.json -> training_contract.optimizer_groups. The per-group clip norms are registered once, there, and reached through the predecessor link above (whose digest is pinned); v4 does not restate them.

feature_standardization.scope: per-dimension mu/sigma computed over the ordered V_fit universe only; the same frozen constants apply in every universe, with no universe-conditional preprocessing (spec §13.19.1)
feature_standardization.consumers: node features, grounding candidates, reconstruction targets, denoising targets, and the generator's shared d -> d_p projection; the raw-token pair encoder and the cosine grounding-pool construction remain on raw F0
feature_standardization.feature_stats_sha256_note: computed at run time from the plan-locked V_fit universe; it is deliberately not a hand-pinned config or registration field

degree_prior_init.rule: the generator degree head's output bias is initialized to mean(log d) over G_fit, with degrees floored at 1 and nodes traversed in sorted order
degree_prior_init.value_note: data-derived from G_fit at run time, not a registered constant; sorted traversal is load-bearing because build_g_fit adds nodes from a frozenset whose iteration order depends on PYTHONHASHSEED, and np.log(...).mean() uses pairwise summation, so an unsorted traversal makes the last ulp order-dependent across ranks
degree_prior_init.log_sigma: deliberately left at its initialization; matching sigma instead of mu measures worse
degree_prior_init.stage_identity: data-derived once from the plan-locked V_fit universe

curriculum.edge_active_entry: from the first edge-active step, trunk, STE, gates, and both conditioning pathways train jointly
curriculum.phase_boundaries: Phase-A/Phase-B boundaries are ceil(0.2T) and ceil(0.2T)+ceil(0.1T) for the registered schedule length T; the phases cover T exactly once at either stage

centered_conditioning.mu_training: mean over pathway-active real rows (edge_mask = 1), all-reduced across ranks
centered_conditioning.mu_eval: each conditioning module uses its single synchronized EMA stored in the checkpoint; there is no rank-local or duplicate EMA for one module

grounding.measured_ceiling_status: reported Phase-0 measurement only; v4 registers no derived pre-binding threshold on it (the v3 G3.1 half-ceiling gate is deleted with its ladder)

pool_method_hash.algorithm: SHA-256 over the following ordered fields
pool_method_hash.shortlist_absence_rule: omit the shortlist-M row entirely when no reranker is present
pool_method_hash.mismatch_policy: fail closed; one role universe or feature-pack digest may never serve another

data_contract.derivation: src/data/internal_holdout.py::derive_internal_holdout over derive_partition(train positives, seed=data.partition_seed, msg_fraction=0.8); V_hold is the union of the two historical hashed-frontier BFS prefixes drawn with the g5-v2-qual| and g5-v2-select| salts, the first removed before the second is taken

fit_manifest.unchanged_from_v2: V_fit, e_msg_fit, e_sup_fit and every digest keyed on them are bit-identical to the two-holdout construction the union replaces

hold_manifest.identity: V_hold := V_qual union V_select; a single 512-node validation universe serving BOTH stages
hold_manifest.assembly: exact gold-density threshold over the complete non-self V_hold pair universe
hold_manifest.metric_config: pinned clustering-coefficient histogram bins and RBF-kernel configuration (raw biased squared MMD per topology_metric)
hold_manifest.composition: 1,533 = 456 (former V_qual) + 807 (former V_select) + 270 cross-side message edges that the two-holdout construction quarantined and used for nothing
hold_manifest.positive_growth_vs_v_select: 1.9x more positives (807 -> 1,533) over 4x more pairs (32,640 -> 130,816); AP sampling SD therefore shrinks only about sqrt(1.9) ~ 1.4x
hold_manifest.known_limitation: V_hold's gold graph is a truncated BFS prefix: its nodes carry degree-sum 9,390 in the full G_msg but only 3,066 inside E_msg[V_hold] (33% retained). Selection against clustering_histogram(gold) therefore partly rewards fidelity to the cut. Pre-existing; the union mitigates it by retaining the cross-side edges but does not remove it.
hold_manifest.disclosed_weakening: The prevalence + 0.02 eligibility floor keeps its inequality form but its absolute value falls from 0.0447 (V_select alone) to 0.0317 (V_hold), a 29% reduction in the floor credited with preventing the 2026-07-19 v1 degenerate-checkpoint failure. Re-pinning the additive 0.02 would be an owner decision; v4 does not re-pin it.

checkpoint_selection.first_eligible_time: after the conditioning ramp and one complete full-joint (Phase-C) epoch, independently of world size
checkpoint_selection.aggregation: complete global V_hold manifest after exact DDP gather; fp32 average_precision_score on binary labels, with unweighted Brier/ECE reported for calibration
checkpoint_selection.warm_reference: measured immediately after the last Phase-A update, in evaluation mode, on the complete V_hold pair manifest and written to immutable run metadata; runtime collapse monitoring uses a fixed slice of that manifest
checkpoint_selection.topology_metric: raw biased squared MMD between the single exact-gold-density predicted-graph and gold-graph clustering-coefficient histograms under the pinned histogram bins and RBF-kernel configuration: MMD_clust_raw^2 = mmd_squared([h_clust(G_pred)], [h_clust(G_gold)]). It is raw single-graph clustering MMD-squared - NOT a density ratio ('RD') and NOT the normalized multi-sample MMD ratio used by the external assembled-graph evaluator. Model-selection evidence only, never external held-out scientific evidence.
full_and_p0_eligibility: all finite and gradient guards pass for the epoch
checkpoint_selection.pair_topology_eligibility: finite/gradient guards; std(pair_topology)>=1e-4; AUPRC(pair_topology)>=label prevalence+0.02; active topology-conditioning fixed-replay gradient norm >=1e-8
checkpoint_selection.eligibility_stage_policy: Every condition above is telemetry-only and cannot prevent selection, completion, publication, scoring, or evaluation.
checkpoint_selection.selection: among all completed epochs, maximize validation AUPRC; retain every model-quality predicate as telemetry only
checkpoint_selection.auprc_tolerance_rule: fixed experiment-plan selection band shared unchanged by all six trained arms; it requires no preliminary run or calibration artifact
checkpoint_selection.tie_break: lower unweighted validation Brier score, then earlier epoch
forbidden: publishing a checkpoint that is not bound to this run's plan/config/artifact provenance
silently substituting a checkpoint from another run
checkpoint_selection.no_eligible_checkpoint: not a blocking state; quality eligibility is telemetry only

stability_guards.measurement: each step: replicated DDP-averaged per-group norm from fp64 local sum with cross-rank equality assertion; fixed replay every 50 steps: isolated active-family x shared-group norms
immediate_abort: non-finite gradient element, optimizer-group norm, family norm, or submodule RMS
stability_guards.reference_validity: warm-start-end dispersion is recorded as telemetry; a finite threshold miss does not abort
stability_guards.quality_policy: All finite model-quality thresholds in stability_guards and collapse_abort are telemetry-only. Actual registered clipping and complete telemetry remain unchanged.
stability_guards.binding_margin: retired as an authorization or publication gate; clip/family/submodule-RMS summaries remain telemetry
stability_guards.abort_consequence: Only truthfulness/safety failures such as non-finite state, DDP disagreement, boundary/coverage violations, or I/O/infrastructure failure abort publication.
stability_guards.last_checkpoint: published according to the plan-selected fallback and bound to run provenance

probe_artifact.formal_scope: all operative train nodes over train-side G_struct
probes: Pi-consistency v2: plan mass on double-Hungarian same-identity cells divided by total plan mass
shared-neighbor-count R2 from mean-pooled STE pair states
probe_artifact.verdict_effect: none - output telemetry only; no probe is an execution gate (spec §14.4.7)

metrics.reporting_rule: Edge-level and assembled-graph metrics are always reported together; no single-metric-family claim (protocol §E5, methodology §6).
assembled_graph: clustering MMD ratio at the canonical operating point
metrics.naming_rule: The three MMD ratios are never aggregated into a composite and no composite is ever called 'graph similarity'. Global simple-edge RD and BFS-macro RD are named separately, always (CLAUDE.md).
telemetry_only: per-validation correlation of (full - f_logit) with endpoint degree
gate tanh magnitudes, optimizer-group norms, family-by-shared-group norms, and gradient cosines

comparator_note: carried over from the frozen-s0 screen; b0_cal_selfdensity is the empirically strongest arm there and remains the bar

operating_point.canonical: density-matched threshold on non-self candidate rows against target_edges = |E(strip_self_loops(test))|
operating_point.matched: per comparator, realize its exact non-self edge quota by descending pass-1 score with the registered deterministic boundary tie-break

acceptance_thresholds_provenance: Every entry in primary_criteria, guards, operating_point, comparators, evaluator, e2e_rules, verdict_rule and failure_reading below is copied verbatim in substance from the BINDING v2 registration named as predecessor above; no threshold is new. They were never part of the 2026-07-27 G3.4/G3.5 circularity (that loop was scoring -> BINDING -> thresholds for the deleted PRE-BINDING gates); they were satisfiable under v2 and are what produced the published 2026-07-24 cut. Protocol §5.2.4 requires them recorded before any held-out metric is opened, which this DRAFT does. The only edit is the control identity: v2's structure_control_6a becomes v3/v4's structure_control_6a_v3 under the spec §14.4.6 arm-schema migration.

criteria: clustering-MMD ratio strictly lower than every comparator at the canonical operating point
BFS-macro GS strictly higher than every comparator at that comparator's matched-global-RD quota
BFS-macro RD strictly higher than every comparator at the same matched quota

pathway_attribution.metric: clustering_mmd_ratio at the canonical operating point
pathway_attribution.rule: formal pass requires G_full > 0 and G_pt >= 0.25 * G_full
pathway_attribution.reading_on_fail: if G_full<=0, no gain is established relative to matched f-only; if G_full>0 but the share fails, topology contribution is insufficient and the headline is withdrawn

structure_control_condition.rule: paired bootstrap over 500 fixed evaluation subgraphs with shared resample indices, B=1000, seed=0, alpha=0.05; require 2.5th percentile of clu(structure_control_6a_v3)-clu(full) > 0
structure_control_condition.scope: fixed-training-seed evaluator sampling stability only, not cross-seed inference
structure_control_condition.structure_control_6e_v1: scored, published and read alongside 6a-v3, but carries NO verdict inequality: v2 registered exactly one structure-control condition and v4 re-pins that one. Registering a threshold for 6e-v1 would be a new pre-registered decision rule, which is an owner action, not a re-pin.
structure_control_condition.reading_on_fail: the registered control did not establish that intact relational connectivity is necessary beyond retained topology-derived node features

liveness_within_checkpoint.death_rule: residual ratio <1e-5 AND Spearman(full,f_logit)>0.9999 AND top-1% overlap>0.9999
liveness_within_checkpoint.consequence: run-validity failure before held-out topology metrics

e2e_rules.four_logit_decomposition: full, f_logit, pair_content, and pair_topology per scored pair for every scored arm/artifact, fp32, provenance egostitch_e2e_pair_fp32_v1, per-array resolution guard; diagnostic only

verdict_rule: post-run scientific report is pass iff full passes all primary criteria and both guards, G_full>0, attribution share passes, and structure control passes; failures are multi-label cut reasons, while model-quality telemetry never blocks execution or evaluation

failure_reading.training_invalid: The registered optimization process did not produce a numerically valid and eligible checkpoint; no architecture-level held-out conclusion is permitted.
failure_reading.primary_fail: The stable topology-conditioned encoder does not beat calibrated independent scoring at this stage.
failure_reading.guard_fail: The model exceeded the registered edge-ranking degradation or degree-MMD guard.
failure_reading.attribution_fail: No gain over matched f-only was established, or the topology share was insufficient; withdraw the topology-representation headline.
failure_reading.structure_control_fail: The registered control did not establish that intact relational connectivity is necessary beyond retained topology-derived node features at this fixed seed.
failure_reading.classification_order: training_invalid first and no scientific verdict; otherwise report every applicable primary_fail, guard_fail, attribution_fail, and structure_control_fail label and return cut if any is present

formal_stage.enforceable_property: one scoring epoch per (arm, seed); no re-scoring after seeing results
formal_stage.not_claimed: 'test opened exactly once' is NOT claimed and would be false: scoring shards across every visible GPU with each shard independently reading candidate_test_edges.txt, and load_test_graph is called at three sites. The v2 screen spent about 24.5 h across five candidate-scoring passes.
formal_stage.ledger: an append-only test-access ledger is written at each held-out _resolve_pairs call and checked into the run artifacts; re-scoring is permitted only with a recorded reason and it is visible in the ledger
formal_stage.selection_boundary: arm AND checkpoint selection happen on V_hold, never on test; ranking arms on test and promoting a winner would be test-set selection bias and would void the ablation table
formal_stage.thresholds_before_read: every acceptance threshold above is present in run metadata before the first held-out metric is opened (protocol §5.2.4)

selection_exposure_disclosure.hazard: Repeated formal-plan development against V_hold can inflate model-selection exposure and bias the full vs b0_e2e_f_only contrast.
selection_exposure_disclosure.accepted: This limitation is disclosed; it does not create an execution gate.
selection_exposure_disclosure.mitigation: record K, the formal run's cumulative V_hold evaluation count per arm, in the result artifact.

candidate_manifest.identity_rule: every scored artifact must match row count, canonical pair order, labels, self-pair mask, and manifest SHA-256 exactly

b0cal_results.lineage: immutable deliverable produced 2026-07-14 by src.experiments.b0_cal from the frozen B0 V3.1 candidate universe (checkpoint_id e092537d8cf1e208, model_family v3_1, 2,037,171 candidate rows) plus the same-checkpoint val artifact (21,456 rows) and the registered g3_results input; its embedded metadata cross-checks the G3 B0 threshold exactly (0.7943849604299823) and b0_cal_selfdensity remains the empirically strongest comparator arm

execution_order: resolve every binding_prerequisite and let the owner promote a successor content state to BINDING
train each registered arm under the single plan-bound formal schedule
publish the plan-selected checkpoint even when model-quality telemetry misses
score all registered candidate artifacts, one scoring epoch per (arm, seed), recording the test-access ledger
produce the formal_train representation probe and run the formal G5 evaluator

artifact_versions.old_version_policy: older probe and scores metadata versions are rejected, not upgraded

inherited_evaluation_contract.rule: The v2 edge-level plus assembled-graph reporting, fixed-Seed-0 claim limits, comparator identities, density-matched operating point, four-logit decomposition, and fail-closed publication rules continue except where spec §13.19/§14.4 or this v4 draft explicitly supersedes them.
inherited_evaluation_contract.no_implicit_binding: Inheritance does not import v2 binding evidence, implementation/config hashes, checkpoints, qualification results, or artifact provenance.

binding_evidence.draft_state: The nulls below are the unresolved binding evidence. Every consuming validator already fails closed on a null (src/train_egostitch.py::_validate_e2e_formal_binding, src/experiments/g5_stage1.py::_validate_e2e_binding_evidence, src/score_universe.py::_validate_e2e_scoring_provenance), so no text marker is needed and none is used: a DRAFT cannot be mistaken for a resolved BINDING state.
binding_evidence.configs_pinned_at: 2026-07-30, against the six v3-named configs after the single-stage cleanup: feature_standardization zscore_vfit_v1, no hand-pasted feature_stats_sha256, runtime.token_budget scalar, retained runtime.total_budget_seconds sum invariant, n_ground-keyed runtime.pack_dir, and preregistration retargeted to this v4 DRAFT. Any further byte change to a config moves its digest and must be re-pinned here before binding.

binding_prerequisites: binding_evidence.implementation names the implementation commit; the formal worker verifies its clean checkout identity.

binding_evidence.parameter_group_manifests, packs_and_validation_manifests, boundary_access_audit and runtime_and_peak_memory each carry path-bound SHA-256 artifacts that resolve and hash-match on the execution host.
The owner promotes the resolved successor content state to BINDING. No agent, screen, or note may do this.

mechanics.formal_worker: must reject this DRAFT; formal egostitch_e2e runs require status == 'BINDING'
mechanics.debug_worker: bounded runs are redirected to a *_debug output directory and marked non-formal; their checkpoints are forbidden from candidate/test scoring
mechanics.owner_boundary: only the owner binds; this draft must not be promoted automatically
mechanics.amendment: any post-binding scientific, threshold, optimizer, schedule, precision, guard, eligibility, or frozen-input change requires a new versioned registration
